notes.title: Smile For Me has been updated!
notes.content:
Finally, we’re excited to announce that [b]Smile for Me[/b] has been updated! This patch brings quality of life features to all platforms, with graphical updates and motion control improvements for Nintendo Switch. Check it out today!

Updates to Steam:

[list]
[*] Added possibility to close pause menu with UI Back action.
[*] Added the possibility to close popups with UI Back action.
[*] Added delete save slot mode (delete on confirm button) when entering the saves menu with save slots full popup active.
[*] Added functionality that shows player inventory when it is hidden and use/scroll inventory button was - pressed.
[*] Added possibility to change language in main menu.
[*] Increased texture quality.
[/list]

notes.title: SMILE FOR ME receives New Languages and PORTS April 24!
notes.content:
One month to go! On April 24th, [i]Smile For Me[/i] will be available to play in [b]8 new languages on Steam.[/b]

With help from publisher Serenity Forge, existing owners and new buyers will be able to play the game in [b]Japanese, Chinese (simplified and traditional), Korean, French, Spanish, Russian, German, and Portuguese[/b]!


[h3][b][i]There’s more news![/i][/b][/h3]
Also on April 24th, the game will arrive on [b]Nintendo Switch, Playstation 5/4, Xbox S|X/One![/b]
You can [url=https://www.nintendo.com/store/products/smile-for-me-switch/][b][u]pre-order Smile For Me on the Nintendo Store[/u][/b][/url] or the [b]Nintendo eShop[/b] to play it the day it releases!
You can also [url=https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10005566][b][u]wishlist the game for Playstation 4/5[/u][/b][/url].

[i]Smile For Me[/i] will arrive on consoles April 24th with remastered audio and graphics, easter eggs, and all new language options.

Go to [url=http://limbolane.com/blog/sfm-console-release-date][u]our official website[/u][/url] for more details about the physical edition!


[i][b]PSST-[/b][/i] [b]Did you know that we’re going to be in Boston March 23-25 for PAX East 2023?[/b] We would love to see you! LimboLane will be showing off [i]Smile For Me[/i] on Nintendo Switch and giving away some original sketches by Yugo; plus other goodies! Visit the Serenity Forge booth (#10023) to say hi!

notes.title: Smile For Me Definitive Steam Update!
notes.content:
While preorders are open for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1018850/view/5170726383216616461]Smile For Me on Consoles[/url], players on Steam receive a [i]FREE UPDATE TODAY![/i]

[h3]The [b]Bloom Update[/b] is the definitive version of [i]Smile For Me[/i], in partnership with publisher [url=https://serenityforge.com/]Serenity Forge[/url].[/h3]

Graphics have been updated, visuals improved, and in-game music has gotten a mouthwatering remaster! Smile For Me has never looked or sounded so tasty.
Controller support, new settings, and stability improvements make the game easier than ever to play.
Returning players also should keep an eye out for brand new art and easter eggs, hidden all around the Habitat. [b]What will you discover?[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34753427/0e15de3e285249f18790ff983f141fe4260e17b2.png[/img]

[h3]THAT’S NOT ALL! The game’s DLC has gotten a big upgrade![/h3]
The [i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1065221/Smile_For_Me__Official_Soundtrack/]Smile For Me Digital Soundtrack[/url][/i] has been fully remastered, with 21 gorgeous music tracks - including Louie Zong’s delicious track from our [url=https://twitter.com/LimboLaneGames/status/1605972593520934912]brand new trailer[/url]!
The [i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1065220/Smile_For_Me__Official_Artbook/]Smile For Me Digital Artbook[/url][/i] also has oodles of new content, totaling [b]over 100 pages[/b]. Never-before-seen concept art and commentary by developers Yugo Limbo and Day Lane provide insight into how this weird world was brought to life.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34753427/421cdf7efeed804e6a71e4b93bbe737f7ee7a016.png[/img]

When [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1018850/view/5170726383216616461]Smile For Me releases on consoles[/url] in Spring 2023, Steam users can look forward to new languages on PC! Smile For Me will be playable in French, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian, Chinese, Korean, and Japanese.

There’s tons to sink your teeth into. So bare your fangs, dust off your bouquet, and join your friends at The Habitat!



The Bloom Update is live [i]now[/i] on Steam for Windows and MacOS.



[i]We’ll be making updates and bugfixes as necessary in the coming weeks.
Contact [b]support@serenityforge.com[/b] to report any update-related bugs or issues.[/i]

notes.title: ANNIVERSARY CHARITY SALE!
notes.content:
[h2]Dear Habiticians, of past present and future...[/h2]
Smile For Me was released one year ago today. Today, we released the long-anticipated epilogue, in the form of an interactive webpage.

[h3][url=https://smilefor.today/]Smile For Today[/url] features brand new dialogue from all the Habiticians, and new music by Lucas Saur and EZIA.[/h3]
Most importantly, it features a wide range of work from artists in the Smile For Me community, who have taken to heart the game’s message by being kind, generous, and surprising in their support of one another. [url=https://smilefor.today/]The Habiticians have something to say to you. Why don’t you go see what the hubbub is all about?[/url]



[h2]Right now, the world is a scary place.[/h2] We hope that you can use art to care for yourself and others. But we also ask that you do not turn a blind eye on the injustice and brutality that are inescapable for so many.
[h3][i][url=https://www.reclaimtheblock.org/]During this sale, all of the money we make will be given to Reclaim the Block, as well as local bail and relief funds.[/url][/i][/h3]
We believe strongly that grassroots organizing is the most effective way to combat the deep hurt imposed on black and poc communities.

Let’s make this world better.

[list]
[*][i]As a note:
Steam takes a 30% cut of game sales. If you [url=https://gabelane.itch.io/smileforme]get your steam key from itchio[/url] instead, every single cent will go to grassroots organizations.[/i]
[/list]


From the bottom of our hearts, thank you for a year of kindness and community.
You make us smile.

Sincerely,
LimboLane

-(Hopefully) fixes bug causing Putunia to consume the [spoiler]cape[/spoiler] item, softlocking the game
-Fixes exploit in the [spoiler]tower[/spoiler] that allows out-of-bounds movement
-Fixes typo in the start menu

notes.title: Hotfix released
notes.content:
Hi All!

We've released a new hotfix to address a major bug with saved items. Some save files created since June 3rd have failed to save all of their items. This update should address and repair that bug. In the meantime, it is possible that in the last day and a half, a user might have ended up with a save file that is missing crucial items. We're very sorry if this happened to you, and please feel free to reach out to [url=http://smileformegame.com/support.html]our support email[/url] if you think you're missing items or have questions about whether your save file is softlocked.

This is a precursor to a larger quality of life update which we will roll out tonight or early tomorrow.

Thanks for sticking with us, and sorry about any inconvenience.

Sincerely,
-LL

We’ve released the first patch for Smile For Me! Thanks for reporting bugs and helping us improve the game. We’re currently tracking more potential bugs, so keep support emails coming!

-(Hopefully) fixes bug making it impossible to use the [spoiler]toothbrush[/spoiler] on Kamal. Please use the [url=smileformegame.com/support]support link[/url] to send an email with details if this issue persists after updating your game.
-Starting a new game now backs up the existing Autosave first, to prevent accidentally overwriting progress
-Updates recipe sprite to say “3” mushrooms
-Wallus now reacts to the Photo of Tim Tam
-Fixes Kamal’s clue to the location of the [spoiler]toothbrush[/spoiler]
-Edits the “7” and “1” on [spoiler]Habit’s[/spoiler] wall to be more easily distinguishable
-Updates Gillis’s photo to show his full name
